messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays you’ll see in Canada for 2023. These are the statutory holidays that either fall on a Friday/Monday or are observed on a Monday when they land on a weekend, giving you a three‑day break:

| Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday(s) Covered | Notes |
|--------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day falls on Sunday; observed Monday gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Family Day is on Monday Feb 20. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday & Easter Monday (some provinces observe Easter Monday) | Good Friday is on Friday Apr 7; Easter Monday is on Monday Apr 10 (not a federal holiday, but many provinces observe it). |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is on Monday May 22. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day falls on Saturday Jul 1; observed Monday Jul 3 gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is on Monday Sep 4. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is on Monday Oct 9. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Remembrance Day falls on Saturday Nov 11; observed Monday Nov 13 gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day is on Monday Dec 25. |

**What’s missing?**  
- Boxing Day (Dec 26) falls on a Tuesday, so it doesn’t create a long weekend.  
- Some provinces also observe St. Patrick’s Day (Mar 17) or other regional holidays that could add extra days off, but those aren’t nationwide.

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
